definitions.title: Unified Polar Equation of Conics
definitions.latex: r = \frac{e d}{1 \pm e \cos(\theta)} \quad \text{or} \quad r = \frac{e d}{1 \pm e \sin(\theta)}
definitions.statement: A conic section with one focus placed at the pole and directrix at distance d from the pole has a single unified polar equation governed entirely by eccentricity e.
definitions.explanation: Eliminates disparate Cartesian formulas: e < 1 (ellipse), e = 1 (parabola), e > 1 (hyperbola).
definitions.keyTakeaway: A single polar equation describes all conic sections with focus at the origin.
